title: Veterans Pension Unreimbursed Medical Expenses and the Retroactive Report Window
content:
# Unreimbursed medical expenses — Veterans Pension

**What reduces countable income.** Unreimbursed medical expenses — insurance premiums including Medicare Part B, in-home attendant and assisted-living care costs, and out-of-pocket treatment — reduce countable income on a Veterans Pension award.

**Prospective rate.** Recurring expenses are annualized over the product's annualization period (12 months) for the prospective rate.

**Annual total.** The annual total for the evaluated period — the sum of the medical expense amounts on the reported expenses whose expense period lies inside that twelve-month period (the calendar year for a retroactive report, the next twelve months for a prospective one) — replaces the prior figure, and any resulting increase for months already paid is released as a retroactive payment.

## The retroactive report window

Unreimbursed medical expenses for a past expense period are used for a retroactive adjustment only if they are reported not later than 12 calendar months after the last day of the expense period. Add the months to the last day of the expense period; when the resulting month has no such day, use the last day of that month, and a report received on that date is timely.

- The clock starts on the last day of the expense period shown on the report.
- The comparison is the date the report was received against that deadline: received on or before it is timely; received after it is late.
- The deadline day itself is inside the window.
- The expense period end comes from the report on record; the date of receipt is the date VA received that same report.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Expense period ends | Deadline | Received | Used retroactively |
|---|---|---|---|
| December 31, 2024 | December 31, 2025 | December 31, 2025 | Yes — received on the deadline |
| December 31, 2024 | December 31, 2025 | January 1, 2026 | No — one day late |
| February 29, 2024 | February 28, 2025 (February 2025 has no 29th) | February 28, 2025 | Yes |
| February 29, 2024 | February 28, 2025 | March 1, 2025 | No |
